lifecycle.method: Disposable Vitest worker probe transpiles the actual three test sources to intercept registration and collect their unmodified callbacks. It calls actual hooks and test bodies in that worker with real production modules and helper implementations; dependency wrappers inject faults. Presence/value assertions execute immediately after the actual cleanup callback, before the outer probe restores its controlled input.
lifecycle.search: Both engines: normal completion and failure after configure; throwing collection resolver primes real cache. Before/after collection and per-test cleanup, compare exact incoming disable; a new C2C_RG_PATH sentinel detects stale resolver cache.
lifecycle.git: Normal test, failing gitInfo, and failing makeGitRepo setup. afterAll restoration checked before first directory cleanup; cleanup itself deliberately throws in the setup failure case.
lifecycle.workspace: All four test bodies normal and getStateDir throwing after mutation for uniform and mixed incoming values. Additional case verifies local restore returns to the preceding isolateStateDir value, preserving separate suite ownership.

lifecycle.limitations: The disposable probe dispatches captured original hooks manually; it does not replace the real Vitest runner. Normal/filtered acceptance runs use the unchanged repository Vitest configuration. Installed Vitest runner behavior was independently checked to invoke afterAll after a beforeAll failure.
